dedupe_keys.name: one million home synthetic urban residential energy stock

description: This Mendeley Data release provides synthetic building-energy inputs and outputs for more than one million urban residential cases. University College Dublin researchers generated terraced, detached, semi-detached and bungalow variants using jEPlus parameter sampling, EnergyPlus thermal simulations and construction templates from DesignBuilder. The current public version 5 contains one CSV dataset and an Excel README under CC BY 4.0. Inputs cover nineteen building and system parameters, including envelope U-values, HVAC and renewable equipment; the principal output is energy-use intensity. Coverage is a generated building stock intended for performance analysis, not a measured national dwelling census or household meter series. Template assumptions and sampled parameter distributions limit how directly the synthetic stock can represent a specific city. A reviewer-assessed use is benchmarking urban building-energy scenarios or testing stock-level sensitivity. model-energyplus is the documented simulation engine, while no independent validation of all million synthetic cases was performed in this review. The article cites version 1; version 5 is the current repository release. No CSV rows, workbook contents or simulation runs were downloaded. A limitation is the lack of independently measured energy for all generated cases.
